name: hotplug-song
about: Plugged and unplugged mid-song, two robots: robot a plays the controller (cable 0) to robot b, the synth (cable 0), and both unplug themselves in software, a every 2 s for 300 ms (2 ms into a note, so the P4 must release it) and b every 3 s for 400 ms. One pass is 60 s: 30 + 20 unplugs; --duration 1h gives 3,000. Messages near an unplug are lost_unplugged, not loss; a note-off the P4 sends at b while a is gone is released, not extra; a robot's own unplug clears what it held. note_hold catches a note held past 20 ms (the gate is 5), so an unreleased note fails even when a later note-off for its key ends it. remounted fails a replug the host never mounts within 2 s. P4 config: a cable 1 -> b cable 1, releasing a departed source's notes.
